request.state: This is a fresh bounded Can design decision prompted by real source drafts. Two applications, one chat and one ComfyUI studio, independently wrote four transport-to-domain bridge handlers, a local snapshot event and mutable sequence/state fields before their meaningful quota settlement and output creation. The shared standard adapters already must durably correlate original frozen request/source/revision to provider evidence, normalize ordered cumulative snapshots and cancellation/unknown outcomes, and finalize output files. The language already specifies typed durable sends, protected delivery associations and receipt leaf grants/fenced reads, verified asynchronous events, atomic domain transactions and reauthorized polling pages. Earlier JEV advice selected typed snapshot contracts against a new run DSL and event log; an associated-receipt progress alternative was absent. The user now explicitly asks for primitives revealed by complex apps. Complete outcomes remain unchanged: private immutable branches, editable then immutable published image workflows, success-only reviewed collections, bounded tokens/jobs, reconnect to the same work, current read/file revocation, independent external stop and no false business success from accepted transport. Losing every-token replay is acceptable. Pending/pre-ack observations and stop-before-start tombstones need durable original-request association. Reused identity with changed input must fail, replacing a handle must not redirect stale work, terminal execution cannot regress though missing usage can settle once later, and accepted provider evidence must survive an app callback failure. Latest final usage/content must be available after restart and explicit reconciliation. Every alternative must meet these obligations; this is not a comparison of implemented products.

observed_progress.instructions: Which limited authoring contract best balances removing repeated infrastructure, understandable business policy, reliable authorization/recovery and the new specification/implementation work needed?

criteria.app_snapshots: Continue with existing send/associated receipt/events only, keeping each apps projection and start/cancel/reconcile/changed bridge handlers. Adapter normalization remains shared. This retains the current receipt contract and explicit source control of projections; it costs repeated plumbing and ties visible progress to the app handler succeeding.
criteria.associated_progress: Permit manifest-declared observable operations to expose typed delivery.progress plus a durable operation.progressed notification. Declare the start/change/cancel/reconcile routing once in the standard interface manifest. Use existing receipt association/read grants/revision fences while runtime stores the verified current snapshot and preserves original file lineage. Apps remove mirror fields and bridges, rendering that progress and retaining one idempotent business settlement/materialization handler. This is a small reusable extension with callback-failure isolation, but requires precise new correlation, disclosure, retry and fixture rules.
criteria.run_construct: Create a separate native run primitive and source forms for starting, cancelling, observing and reconciling it. Standard generated presentation and adapter state reduce repeated boilerplate while quotas/business records stay authored. Its dedicated concept may serve future jobs well, but requires a larger new language/type/effect model and replay/authority/target-output design now.
